complexity.notes: The generator expression is a mild improvement over the previous list comprehension; math.ceil(pile/k) could be written as -(-pile // k) to stay in integers, but this is purely stylistic.
complexity.summary: Binary searches the eating speed k in [1, max(piles)], testing feasibility with a linear pass that sums ceil(pile/k) hours per pile. The monotonic predicate (higher k always feasible if lower k is) guarantees the minimal feasible k is found.
complexity.time_average: O(n log M), where M = max(piles)
complexity.time_worst: O(n log M), where M = max(piles)
